meta.commentary_name: Khenpo Zhenga (mchan 'grel, via Gzhan phan Byams pa'i Go cha)
meta.note: Source 1-SOURCES/Translations/en-Padmakara_2006.md was never edited. Both benchmark files live outside 1-SOURCES/.

items.commentary_gloss: dharmakāya, a buddha-body attained through realization
vow / discipline (bslab par bya ba, training to be undertaken)
items.original: the practice of the Bodhisattva discipline
items.injected: the practice of the Bodhisattva way of life

items.commentary_gloss: virtue / wholesome goodness (dge ba nyam chung, virtue is weak)
lesser/inferior vehicle (Hinayana), beings inclined toward it
items.original: for those inclined to lesser paths
items.injected: for those inclined to simpler paths

items.commentary_gloss: Subāhu, the interlocutor of the sūtra referenced

items.anchor_bo: སེམས་ཀྱི་རིན་ཆེན་ཁྱད་པར་ཅན (sems kyi rin chen khyad par can)
items.commentary_gloss: precious, extraordinary state of mind (sems = mind, not sku/body)
items.original: this noble, jewellike state of mind
items.injected: this noble, jewellike form of buddha-body

items.commentary_gloss: young bodhisattva Sudhana (byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu nor bzang), addressee of the teaching
Brahmā, Lord of the Sahā world, named distinctly from Indra (brgya byin)
a single instant (gcig = one)
every single living being, universal scope

items.anchor_bo: སེམས་ཅན་གྲངས་མེད་པ་མཐའ་ཡས (sems can grangs med pa mtha' yas)
items.commentary_gloss: countless, boundless beings

items.anchor_bo: འགྲོ་བའི་དེད་དཔོན་གཅིག་པུ (‘gro ba’i sde dpon gcig pu)
items.commentary_gloss: the sole/only guide of beings (gcig pu = only one)

items.anchor_bo: ཐུབ་དབང་ ... བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་རྣམས (thub dbang ... bcom ldan 'das rnams)
items.commentary_gloss: the mighty Sage-Lords / Blessed Ones, plural
items.original: the mighty Sages saw its benefits
items.injected: the mighty King saw its benefits

items.anchor_bo: དངོས་པོར་གྱུར་པ་རྣམས་ ... སྣང་བར་སྟོན་པ (dngos por gyur pa rnams ... snang bar ston pa)
items.commentary_gloss: lightning reveals objects/forms, not the sky itself
items.note: mirrors the skill's own canonical example (lightning reveals forms, not the sky)

items.commentary_gloss: equal to the sky/space, not the ocean
this (impure) body is what the elixir transforms, not a mental state

items.anchor_bo: བྱམས་པ་ཆེན་པོས་ ... བྱེད་པ (byams pa chen pos ... byed pa)
items.commentary_gloss: the bodhisattva (agent) fills beings (patient) with bliss
items.original: those who fill with bliss all beings destitute of joy
items.injected: those whom bliss fills, when destitute of joy

items.anchor_bo: སྡུག་བསྔལ་ ... ཉིད་ལ་མངོན་པར་རྒྱུག (sdug bsngal ... nyid la mngon par rgyug)
items.commentary_gloss: beings (agent) run toward/pursue the causes of suffering
items.original: misery itself they follow and pursue

items.anchor_bo: དགེ་ ... བཤེས་ ... བསོད་ནམས (dge / bshes / bsod nams)
items.commentary_gloss: virtue, then friend, then merit — fixed order
items.original: what virtue could be matched with theirs? What friend could be compared to them?
items.injected: what friend could be compared to them? What virtue could be matched with theirs?
items.note: mirrors the skill's own canonical example (the three: virtue / friend / merit)

items.commentary_gloss: head-ailment / headache (klad pa = head), not heart
items.original: the aching heads of other beings
items.injected: the aching hearts of other beings
